records.description: Loss arising from a counterparty failing to meet its obligations.
Loss arising from movements in market prices.
Loss arising from inadequate or failed processes, people and systems, or from external events.
Inability to meet obligations as they fall due without incurring unacceptable loss.
Loss arising from failure to comply with laws, regulations or internal standards.
Loss arising from adverse business decisions or failure to respond to change.
Loss arising from damage to standing with customers, counterparties or the public.
Failure, disruption or obsolescence of technology.
Loss arising from malicious activity against systems or data.
Loss arising from reliance on external suppliers and service providers.
Loss arising from mishandling of data, including personal information.
Loss arising from errors in the design, implementation or use of models.
Loss arising from behaviour that harms clients or market integrity.
Loss arising from money laundering, sanctions breaches, fraud or bribery.
Loss arising from physical and transition effects of climate change.
